entities.name: Antonio Ignacio de la Pedrosa y Guerrero
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antonio de la Pedrosa y Guerrero was an attorney in Spain and in Santa Fe de Bogotá, a member of the Council of the Indies, and the first (provisional) viceroy of New Granada, from June 13, 1718, to November 25, 1719.
